topic: Getting a Bike Fixed at a Shop

script.title: THE BIKE DOCTOR
script.story_hook: A squeaky old bike meets the friendliest mechanic.
script.intro_zh: 一台吱吱作響的老單車，遇上了最親切的技師。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to today's bike repair shop. Listen for fixing and pricing phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的單車修理店。留意維修與計費的說法。
script.outro: Squeaks gone, bell ringing, rider smiling. Listen once more and repeat.
script.outro_zh: 怪聲沒了，鈴鐺響了，騎士笑了。再聽一遍，跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat every line together now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a college-age young man in his early twenties with shaggy dirty-blonde hair under a backwards cap, freckles, a faded green band t-shirt, rolled khaki shorts, ankle socks with slides, and a lanky build
script.char_b_description: a sturdy mechanic in his forties with a shaved head, thick dark eyebrows, a few days of stubble, a navy work apron over a flannel shirt with rolled sleeves, worn gloves, and a wide build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, this bike is making a sad squeak.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ðɪs baɪk ɪz ˈmeɪkɪŋ ə sæd skwik/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，這台單車發出好哀怨的吱吱聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sad squeak, got it. Show me the patient.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæd skwik ɡɑɾ ɪt ʃoʊ mi ðə ˈpeɪʃənt/
dialogue.zh: 哀怨吱吱聲，收到。讓我看看這位「病患」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, um, she's fourteen years old.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ɪt ɪz ʌm ʃiz fɔːrˈtin jɪɹz oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 就是這台，嗯，牠已經十四歲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Older than some of my customers, wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊldɚ ðæn sʌm əv maɪ ˈkʌstəməz waʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哇，比某些顧客的年紀還大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's my college bike, she deserves respect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiz maɪ ˈkɑˌlɪdʒ baɪk ʃɚ dɪˈzɝvz rɪˈspɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的大學舊車，牠當得起一份敬意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely. So, what does the squeak sound like?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæbsəˈlutli soʊ wʌt dʌz ðə skwik saʊnd laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 應該的。那，吱吱聲聽起來是什麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, squeak, squeak, like that every time I brake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm skwik skwik laɪk ðæt ˈɛvɹi taɪm aɪ breɪk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，就是這樣，每次煞車就吱吱叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. That's your brake pads, cheap fix.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ðæts jɔɹ bɹeɪk pædz tʃip fɪks/
dialogue.zh: 明白了。是煞車皮的問題，小錢就能修好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh great. Anything wrong with the wheel?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡɹeɪt ˈɛniθɪŋ ɹɔŋ wɪð ðə wil/
dialogue.zh: 那太好了。輪圈那一邊應該沒事吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wheel's fine, but the tire's a bit flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wilz faɪn bʌt ðə ˈtaɪɚz ə bɪt flæt/
dialogue.zh: 車圈沒事，不過胎有點洩氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, um, that's problem number two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛɑ ʌm ðæts ˈpɹɑbləm ˈnʌmbɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，嗯，那是第二個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Puncture in the tube, easy patch today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʌŋkʧɚ ɪn ðə tub ˈizi pætʃ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 內胎破了個小洞，今天補起來很容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you patch it while I wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən ju pætʃ ɪt waɪl aɪ weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 可以趁我等待的時候順便補好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, tops, for the tube.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts tɑps fɚ ðə tub/
dialogue.zh: 內胎最多二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I've got errands nearby anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪv ɡɑt ˈɛɹəndz ˈnɪɹˌbaɪ ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 正好，我附近本來就有事要辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Meanwhile, want me to check the brakes fully?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈminˌwaɪl wɑnt mi tə tʃɛk ðə bɹeɪks ˈfʊli/
dialogue.zh: 那期間，要不要我完整檢查煞車？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, they feel kind of mushy lately.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ðeɪ fil kaɪnd əv ˈmʌʃi ˈleɪtli/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，手感最近有點軟軟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mushy lever means air in the line, probably.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌʃi ˈlɛvɚ minz ɛɹ ɪn ðə laɪn ˈpɹɑbəbli/
dialogue.zh: 把手偏軟，大概是油管跑進空氣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that dangerous, or just annoying?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈdeɪndʝɚəs ɔɹ dʒʌst əˈnɔɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那危險嗎，還是只是困擾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, honestly, so we'll bleed them today.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ˈɑnəstli soʊ wil blid ðɛm təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 老實說兩者都是，所以今天來放油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bleed them? This bike has feelings now?
dialogue.phonetic: /blid ðɛm ðɪs baɪk hæz ˈfilɪŋz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 放油？這台車難道有感情了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, bleeding just means clearing the old fluid.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈblidi dʒʌst minz ˈklɪɹɪŋ ði oʊld ˈfluˌɪd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，「放油」只是清掉舊的油液。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, doctor bike is in good hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈdɑktɚ baɪk ɪz ɪn ɡʊd hænz/
dialogue.zh: 好，單車醫生技術過硬，我放心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, how's the shifting up front?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ haʊz ðə ˈʃɪftɪŋ ʌp fɹʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 那，前面變速換檔順不順？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, third gear skips when it's uphill.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm θɝd ɡɪɹ skɪps wɛn ɪts ʌpˈhɪl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，上坡掛三檔會跳檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cable stretch, five-minute adjustment on the barrel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkeɪbəl stɹɛt faɪv ˈmɪnɪt əˈdʒʌstmənt ɑn ðə ˈbæɹəl/
dialogue.zh: 變速線鬆了，轉鈕調一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're finding a lot of five-minute fixes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈfaɪndɪŋ ə lɑt əv faɪv ˈmɪnɪt fɪksɪz/
dialogue.zh: 你發現好多五分鐘就能搞定的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes here, thirty dollars there, adds up.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnɪts hɪɹ ˈθɝdi ˈdɑləz ðɛɹ ædz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 五分鐘加三十大塊，這樣疊起來可觀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, thirty dollars? For a five-minute fix?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ˈθɝdi ˈdɑləz fɚ ə faɪv ˈmɪnɪt fɪks/
dialogue.zh: 等等，三十塊？修一個五分鐘的問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the tune-up rate, not one fix.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈtunˌʌp ɹeɪt nɑt wʌn fɪks/
dialogue.zh: 那是一整套保養的價位，不是單項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, so one tune-up covers all of this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ soʊ wʌn ˈtunˌʌp ˈkʌvɚz ɔl əv ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 喔，所以一次保養就把這些全涵蓋？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pads, brakes, gears, tires, lights, everything checked.
dialogue.phonetic: /pædz bɹeɪks ɡɪɹz ˈtaɪɚz laɪts ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ tʃɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 煞車皮、煞車、變速、輪胎、車燈全查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That actually sounds like a fair deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈæktʃuəli saʊndz laɪk ə fɛɹ dil/
dialogue.zh: 這樣聽起來其實蠻划算的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's forty-five with new pads included.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈfɔɾi faɪv wɪð nju pædz ɪnˈkluːdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 若含全新煞車皮，則是四十五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty-five... um, my budget said thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɾi faɪv ʌm maɪ ˈbʌdʒɪt sɛd ˈθɝdi/
dialogue.zh: 四十五……嗯，我的預算只有三十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hear that. We can do the basics today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪɹ ðæt wi kən du ðə ˈbeɪsɪks təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我懂。那今天先做最需要的項目。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Patch, brakes bled, and the gear skip?
dialogue.phonetic: /pætʃ bɹeɪks blɛd ænd ðə ɡɪɹ skɪp/
dialogue.zh: 補胎、放油，還有跳檔都修？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, twenty-eight total, pads next month maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈtwɛnti eɪt ˈtoʊɾəl pædz nɛkst mʌnθ ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 對，總共二十八，煞車皮下個月再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal! Oh no... did that just deflate more?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil oʊ noʊ dɪd ðæt dʒʌst dɪˈfleɪt mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 成交！噢不……剛那胎是不是更扁了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's see... ah, the valve core is loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts si æ ðə vælv kɔɹ ɪz lus/
dialogue.zh: 我看看……啊，是氣門芯鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loose valve? Can that pop off?
dialogue.phonetic: /lus vælv kən ðæt pɑp ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 氣門鬆了？會整個飛掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rarely, and we'd simply re-seat it here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɛɹli ænd wid ˈsɪmpli ɹi sit ɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 很少見啦，我們這裡鎖回去就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Simple words, scary situation, please re-seat it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmpəl wɝdz ˈskɛɹi ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən pliz ɹi sit ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你說得輕鬆，我聽得緊張，拜託鎖緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, done and done, it holds air now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ dʌn ænd dʌn ɪt hoʊldz ɛɹ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，搞定收工，現在氣壓穩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a wizard. Is there a waiting bench?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ə ˈwɪzɚd ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈweɪɾɪŋ bɛntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 你簡直是法師。有等待區可以坐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right there, coffee's free, magazines from 2019.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ðɛɹ ˈkɔˌfiz fɹi ˌmæɡəˈzinz fɹəm ˈtwɛnti ˈnɪnətin/
dialogue.zh: 就在那邊，咖啡免費，雜誌是2019年的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Vintage reading, my favorite while I wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɪnˌtɪdʒ ˈɹidɪŋ maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt waɪl aɪ weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 復古讀物，是我等待時的最愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, then squeak-free brakes, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ðɛn skwik-fɹi bɹeɪks ˈpɹɑməs/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘，煞車保證一聲不吭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I also get a small bell?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ɡɛt ə smɑl bɛl/
dialogue.zh: 我可以再買個小鈴鐺嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We've got them, ten bucks, cheerful ding.
dialogue.phonetic: /wiːv ɡɑt ðɛm tɛn bʌks ˈtʃɪɹfəl dɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 有哦，十塊錢，聲音清脆悅耳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect for announcing me to the sidewalk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt fɚ əˈnaʊnsɪŋ mi tə ðə ˈsaɪdˌwɔk/
dialogue.zh: 剛好讓行人知道我要來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pedestrians will be so impressed, I guarantee.
dialogue.phonetic: /pəˈdɛstɹiənz wɪl bi soʊ ɪmˈpɹɛst aɪ ˌɡæɹənˈti/
dialogue.zh: 行人一定會肅然起敬，我打包票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Ring it twice for good luck.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɹɪŋ ɪt twaɪs fɚ ɡʊd lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 哈！好運的暗號是按兩下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That'll be free, luck is my donation.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts bl fri lʊk ɪz maɪ ˌdoʊnˈeɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 那個免費，好運算我贊助的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best shop energy I've found all month.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst ʃɑp ˈɛnɝdʒi aɪv faʊnd ɔl mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 這是我這個月遇過最好的店家氣氛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We try. That's thirty-eight with the bell.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tɹaɪ ðæts ˈθɝdi eɪt wɪð ðə bɛl/
dialogue.zh: 我們很努力。加鈴鐺共三十八塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, please. Wow, that printer is fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd pliz waʊ ðæt ˈpɹɪntɚ ɪz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡。哇，這收據機印得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's older than your bike, but it works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈoʊldɚ ðæn jɔɹ baɪk bʌt ɪt wɝks/
dialogue.zh: 牠比你家單車還老，但還能動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All set? I hear zero squeaks already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl sɛt aɪ hɪɹ ˈzɪɹoʊ skwiks ɔlˈɛɾi/
dialogue.zh: 都好了嗎？我已經聽不到半聲吱吱了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ride safe, and see you next month, pads.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪd seɪf ænd si ju nɛkst mʌnθ pædz/
dialogue.zh: 騎車小心，下個月見，換煞車皮喔。

script.youtube_title: 【單車急診室🚲】「這台車難道有感情了？😂」補胎放油一次搞定🔧｜煞車・變速・費用全學會｜60句沉浸英文聽力｜Getting a Bike Fixed at a Shop
script.youtube_title_en: "This Bike Has Feelings Now?" — Getting a Bike Fixed at a Shop
script.youtube_description:
「放油？這台車難道有感情了？」——推著吱吱作響的老單車走進修理店，會遇到哪些實用的英文？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在溫暖的單車修理鋪。

你會聽到：用英文形容怪聲音、描述煞車軟軟的手感；聽懂補胎、放油、跳檔這些維修說法；詢問整套保養與單項維修的價格差異；當場預算不夠時怎麼改選項；還有順手買個小鈴鐺的輕鬆聊天。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，自然出現美國人對話中的 um、well、so、ha。聽完你就會用：What does it sound like?、Can you do it while I wait?、My budget said thirty、See you next month。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴噹。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Bleed them? This bike has feelings now?" — wheeling a squeaky old bike into a repair shop brings out the best (and funniest) everyday English. This is a 60-line immersive listening practice inside a cozy bike shop.

You will hear: describing strange noises and mushy brakes in English, understanding patch, bleeding and skipped gears, comparing a full tune-up price with single fixes, switching options politely when the budget is tight, and ending with a shiny new bell.

Everything stays in A2-level words with real American rhythm: um, well, so, ha. By the end you'll own phrases like What does it sound like?, Can you do it while I wait?, My budget said thirty, and Ride safe.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
一台十四歲的老單車，煞車吱吱叫、輪胎扁扁的、上坡還會跳檔，維修店裡到底要怎麼用英文描述這些毛病？報價超出預算又該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進單車修理店，從形容怪聲、檢查輪胎煞車、聽懂「放油」這種術語，到比較保養價位、調整維修項目、買小鈴鐺與結帳，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🔧 形容問題：Um, squeak, squeak, like that every time I brake.
💸 談預算：Forty-five... um, my budget said thirty.
🛠️ 改選項：Patch, brakes bled, and the gear skip?
🔔 輕鬆閒聊：Ha! Ring it twice for good luck.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。下次需要維修或報價，這些英文會自己從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你每一次騎車都安安靜靜、快快樂樂。
